senses.gloss: f. (v. אוּפֵי) prop. the large central branch, hence trunk, stalk.
units: Succ. 32ᵃ ואימא א׳ may I not say (as you insist on the palm-branch being kafuth, tied, joined) that I must use the stalk?—
<cite ref="Chullin 47b">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> lungs resembling <he>לא׳</he> a trunk (in color, touch &c.).
Ib. 16ᵃ וי״ו דכתיב אא׳ a Vav. written on a trunk (being broken on account of the rough surface = idle-talk).
